en.title: Maximum Subset Bitwise AND with Limited Increments
en.description:
Perform at most k operations, each adding 1 to any rating. After the changes, choose exactly m items and maximize their bitwise AND.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O and judging; ranges marked as this site's are not original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k m (1≤m≤n≤100000, 1≤k≤10⁹); the second line contains n rating values (1..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: raise 1 to 2 and choose two items, giving an AND of 2; bringing both items to 3 takes 3 operations, which exceeds the budget. Example 2: the only value goes from 5 to 8, so the answer is 8. Example 3: bringing all three items to 2 takes 3 operations but the budget is only 2, so the maximum AND stays 1.
hints: Try answer masks from the high bit to the low bit. Compute the minimum increase each number needs to contain all the 1 bits of the mask; if the sum of the m smallest costs is ≤k, the bit can be kept.
